## Why it is this short
Three reasons. Editing the trigger table or a budget should be a file edit with version history
not a prompt edit with no history. A long prompt competes with the repo for authority and the
model has to guess which wins. And a thin prompt makes the repo the single source of truth
is the only way a memoryless run can behave consistently week to week.
